model_output.rationale: DOS 2024-07-19; Medicare 1-year filing limit = 2025-07-19. 277CA shows claim accepted (STC*A2:20) on 2024-07-23, well within the window. CO-29 denial is wrong — payer has incorrect receipt date. Appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report proving timely filing.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 but 277CA proves acceptance on 2024-07-23, 4 days after DOS 2024-07-19 — well within the 1-year Medicare limit. Receipt date is wrong on payer's end.

next_action.detail: File redetermination within 120 days of remit (2025-11-01). Attach 277CA acceptance report dated 2024-07-23 showing STC*A2:20. Dispute receipt date; do not plead forgiveness.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CO-29 ($38.48 + $42.89), $0 paid, MOA N211
Claim accepted STC*A2:20 on 2024-07-23, within 1 year of DOS 2024-07-19
Patient active Medicare Part B coverage on DOS, EB*1 effective 2024-01-01
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report: dispute the receipt date
Medicare FFS: 1 calendar year from DOS
